coordinate_rule_for_txt: lat/lon projected to meters relative to depot using equirectangular approximation; current solver computes Euclidean distance from these coordinates unless modified to read distance_m file.
vmax_rule: For each unordered edge {i,j}, sample Uniform(30,40) km/h and write symmetric directed vmax_ij in m/s.
theta_rule: For each directed edge i->j and segment l=0..11, theta_ijl=round(Uniform(0.9,1.0)*base_L[l],2).
